scope: Independent preliminary review of six Rome-only source-blind prior fits, inner crossfit and posterior-aware target-only tilt; no data execution or heavy job.

actionable_requirements.requirement: Predict every raw Rome row in each held month, including rows excluded from supervised fit and tilt targets. No known peer-label subtraction. Preserve fixed IFR/quality/membership and missing-source gates; hash row IDs.

Inner model, encoder/category maps, support quantiles/tau and source bias/noise must use only that inner training complement, disjoint from inner held and outer held labels. Define fixed complete-month partitions and calendar-edge exclusions.

Default daily_delay_posterior.fit calls takeoff-day base.fit_noise. Selected joint uses offblock-calendar parameters. Rebuild the original offblock calibration on allowed inner rows; do not reuse outer calibration or accidentally switch calendars.

taxi_count_sum_jan_jul.calibrate requires >=100 supported complete-day source cells and >=100 retained covariance cells. Check fixed complements before prior fit allocation; do not lower thresholds after seeing outcomes.

Freeze raw versus clipped y, four-feature scaling, optimizer, update count, penalty and bounds before evaluation. All three arms share support, incoming priors, frozen assigned dates/memberships and per-target peer likelihood; only theta fitting objective changes.

The new 37-feature LGB prior differs materially from original v70. Score zero-tilt family replacement separately, then prior-MSE versus posterior-MSE under matched conditions. Freeze whether contribution is Jtheta-D0 or Jtheta-Dtheta; the latter is not directly optimized by posterior MSE on Jtheta. Reproduce exact v80 control and original bounded/rounded component route.
Six prior fits plus packet preparation need concrete rounds, memory footprint, source fit counts and host plan. No fit allocation or heavy execution supplied by this review.

nonclaims: Source sensitivity rank does not establish predictive gain.
No new feature mechanism is implied by fitting a small surrogate prior.
Jan/Jul remains reused development data; paired-day intervals are not independent confirmation.
